mapper.insert: INSERT INTO picture_stats (pictureId, viewCount, likeCount, collectCount, downloadCount, shareCount, impressionCount, clickCount, ctr, createTime, updateTime) VALUES (#{stats.pictureId}, COALESCE(#{stats.viewCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{stats.likeCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{stats.collectCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{stats.downloadCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{stats.shareCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{stats.impressionCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{stats.clickCount}, 0), 0.000000, NOW(), NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE viewCount = viewCount + COALESCE(#{stats.viewCount}, 0), likeCount = likeCount + COALESCE(#{stats.likeCount}, 0), collectCount = collectCount + COALESCE(#{stats.collectCount}, 0), downloadCount = downloadCount + COALESCE(#{stats.downloadCount}, 0), shareCount = shareCount + COALESCE(#{stats.shareCount}, 0), impressionCount = impressionCount + COALESCE(#{stats.impressionCount}, 0), clickCount = clickCount + COALESCE(#{stats.clickCount}, 0), ctr = IF(impressionCount > 0 AND clickCount > 0, clickCount / impressionCount, 0.000000), updateTime = NOW()
